**STEP 1 — Scene:** Sliced medium-rare steak with carrots, a few potato pieces, leafy greens, green beans or similar green vegetables, and a garlic/herb topping.

**STEP 2 — Vessel:** A shallow dinner bowl, approximately **27 cm diameter**. Estimated area: 3.14 × 13.5² = **572 cm²**.

**STEPS 3–6 — Items, coverage, volume and weight:** Food covers approximately **72%** of the vessel. Areas below partition that coverage; the oil/dressing coats existing food rather than adding coverage.

| Visible item | Area share | Area × typical height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated weight |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Sliced steak | 22% | 126 cm² × 1.5 cm = 189 ml | 0.95 | 179 g |
| Carrot slices | 19% | 109 cm² × 1.4 cm = 153 ml | 0.65 | 99 g |
| Potato pieces | 8% | 46 cm² × 1.8 cm = 83 ml | 0.65 | 54 g |
| Leafy greens | 17% | 97 cm² × 2 cm = 194 ml | 0.15 | 29 g |
| Green beans/stalks | 5% | 29 cm² × 1.5 cm = 44 ml | 0.60 | 26 g |
| Chopped garlic/herbs | 1% | 6 cm² × 0.5 cm = 3 ml | 1.0 | 3 g |
| Visible oily dressing | Overlay | Approximately 8 ml | ~1.0 | 8 g |
| **Coverage total** | **72%** | | | **398 g** |

**STEP 7 — Energy:** Using cooked-food values: steak 220, carrots 40, potatoes 85, greens 23, green beans 35, garlic/herbs 149, and oil 880 kcal per 100 g. These give approximately **570 kcal total**.

**STEP 8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **400 g and 570 kcal** is plausible for the visible steak and vegetables. The few potato pieces and loose leaves contribute relatively little weight; steak and dressing provide most of the energy.
